objective: Determine the exact optimum number of leaves under saturation and adaptive visible parities for each independent pair of two one-sided XOR summaries on five products.
status: Proved: On five adjacent products every independent pair of fixed XOR summaries from one evaluator needs exactly eight affine-tree leaves and minimum worst-case depth three. Even revealing all five individual product bits on that evaluator has the same optimum.
title: Classify the 35 independent five-product pairs
